description: MATPOWER is a package of M-files for solving power flow, continuation power flow and optimal power flow problems with MATLAB or GNU Octave. It is intended as a simulation tool for researchers and educators that is easy to use and modify while giving the best performance possible with simple code. It is maintained through the matpower.org website and a GitHub project whose master branch holds the stable version. The package is location independent and applies to any network described as a case file; it ships a library of case files. Official versioned releases are downloaded as ZIP files from matpower.org and development versions from GitHub (latest tag 8.1, commits to August 2026). Full features, including the new MP-Core, need MATLAB R2016a or later or GNU Octave 6.2 or later, while legacy features run on older versions. The code is under the 3-clause BSD licence at no cost. Caveats: the case files distributed with MATPOWER are explicitly not covered by the BSD licence, so their terms must be checked individually, and MATLAB itself is commercial although Octave is free. Simulation uses are network flow and optimal power flow analysis and planning studies. Related records: model-powermodels-jl and model-pandapower read MATPOWER case files.
